entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was walking down the corridor tow..."
entries.dialogueText: I was walking down the corridor towards my office on the way back from lunch.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Right next to the door, Lileas, Nia..."
entries.dialogueText: Right next to the door, Lileas, Nia and Karl were waiting. They approached me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Right next to the door, Lileas was..."
entries.dialogueText: Right next to the door, Lileas was waiting. She approached me.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“There has been an important update..."
entries.dialogueText: “There has been an important update on the Koronti investigation.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered the office."
entries.dialogueText: We entered the office.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“An informant from HOS contacted us..."
entries.dialogueText: “An informant from HOS contacted us. He was identified as a low-level executive."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So what did he say?”"
entries.dialogueText: “So what did he say?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Can we trust this informant?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Can we trust this informant?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Go on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Go on.”

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“We have interrogated him thoroughl..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have interrogated him thoroughly and confirmed the information he gave us.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Karl stepped forward and bowed."
entries.dialogueText: Karl stepped forward and bowed.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“We now have proof that a subsidiar..."
entries.dialogueText: “We now have proof that a subsidiary of HOS, Konrath Holdings, is a shell corporation engaged in money laundering for the Koranelli cartel."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Over the past three years, approxi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Over the past three years, approximately 15 million Sordish ren from the Koranellis' drug and weapons smuggling activities has gone through this corporation with Marcel Koronti's implicit approval."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This can't be. This must be a ploy..."
entries.dialogueText: “This can't be. This must be a ploy against HOS or Koronti.”
entries.menuText: “This can't be. This must be a ploy against HOS or Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Whatever you say, there is now eno..."
entries.dialogueText: “Whatever you say, there is now enough evidence.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia frowned at me."
entries.dialogueText: Nia frowned at me.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Why are you so willing to protect..."
entries.dialogueText: “Why are you so willing to protect HOS? Why is it so hard to believe?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All eyes in the room turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: All eyes in the room turned to me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That settles it then. What is the..."
entries.dialogueText: “That settles it then. What is the plan?”
entries.menuText: “That settles it then. What is the plan?”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“The time has come. Frankly, we hav..."
entries.dialogueText: “The time has come. Frankly, we have been preparing for this possibility.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Please follow us to the comms room..."
entries.dialogueText: “Please follow us to the comms room.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia gestured towards the door and I..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia gestured towards the door and I followed the two women down the hall.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nothing. It's just hard to believe..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nothing. It's just hard to believe such a respectable business would stoop to this level.”
entries.menuText: “Nothing. It's just hard to believe such a respectable business would stoop to this level.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“That is why none of these oligarch..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is why none of these oligarchs can be trusted. They would do anything for money.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I stayed silent and did not reply t..."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed silent and did not reply to her question.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Regardless of your uncertainty, we..."
entries.dialogueText: “Regardless of your uncertainty, we will move.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We descended the spiral staircase a..."
entries.dialogueText: We descended the spiral staircase at the very edge of the palace, close to where my office was located.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Going through narrower corridors th..."
entries.dialogueText: Going through narrower corridors than upstairs, we came in front of a large door with a shield and a goat carved on it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia opened the door and we entered...."
entries.dialogueText: Nia opened the door and we entered. After taking our seats, she gave me a sheepish look.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Mr. President. I said we have been..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. I said we have been preparing for this opportunity, but that might've been an understatement.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Our attack teams are ready to go...."
entries.dialogueText: "Our attack teams are ready to go. They've surrounded Mr. Koronti's villa in Estord.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded at Karl. Karl leaned for..."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded at Karl. Karl leaned forward and spoke into the microphone.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Begin.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Begin.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We sat there for a few minutes, wai..."
entries.dialogueText: We sat there for a few minutes, waiting anxiously. Finally, Karl received a radio transmission.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Mr. Koronti has been successfully..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Koronti has been successfully captured.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Well done.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Well done.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I hope we caught the right person...."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope we caught the right person.”
entries.menuText: “I hope we caught the right person.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“There will be consequences for thi..."
entries.dialogueText: “There will be consequences for this.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Now that he's been arrested, Sordl..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now that he's been arrested, Sordland will have one less traitor. We will learn the truth from him directly.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“One way or another.”"
entries.dialogueText: “One way or another.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“All of his contacts, everyone he h..."
entries.dialogueText: “All of his contacts, everyone he has been dealing with.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Of course, and our administration..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course, and our administration will successfully handle it. I am sure.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I want to especially confirm the r..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to especially confirm the rumour about his contact in the administration. We will squeeze every single drop of information we can out from him.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“As you said, one less traitor.”"
entries.dialogueText: “As you said, one less traitor.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am looking forward to the result..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am looking forward to the results.”
entries.menuText: “I am looking forward to the results.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We will bring them to you as quick..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will bring them to you as quickly as possible.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Indeed.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Indeed.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“The news ought to break any moment..."
entries.dialogueText: “The news ought to break any moment now.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“This was all for today, Mr. Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: “This was all for today, Mr. President. We will keep you posted.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Thank you for your time.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your time.”

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They left one by one and I made my..."
entries.dialogueText: They left one by one and I made my way back to my office.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "This could be the end of my preside..."
entries.dialogueText: This could be the end of my presidency. If Marcel talked, everything could end.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There must be a way out of this."
entries.dialogueText: There must be a way out of this.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sordland now felt a little bit safe..."
entries.dialogueText: Sordland now felt a little bit safer now that Marcel had been taken care of.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For how long, I wondered."
entries.dialogueText: For how long, I wondered.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“There has been an update on the Ko..."
entries.dialogueText: “There has been an update on the Koronti investigation.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered the office."
entries.dialogueText: We entered the office.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Unfortunately we were not able to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Unfortunately we were not able to find any leads.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“At this time, we will not be able..."
entries.dialogueText: “At this time, we will not be able to continue the investigation.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“No matter how much we probed into..."
entries.dialogueText: “No matter how much we probed into HOS, no matter how many employees we tried to get insider information from, their mouths were completely shut.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Everyone is innocent until proven..."
entries.dialogueText: “Everyone is innocent until proven guilty, right?”
entries.menuText: “Everyone is innocent until proven guilty, right?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That is truly disappointing.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That is truly disappointing.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Really?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Really?”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“There are many words that describe..."
entries.dialogueText: “There are many words that describe HOS and Koronti and I still believe innocent is not one of them.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Regardless, that doesn't change th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Regardless, that doesn't change the fact that we are currently stuck.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“No need to exaggerate. We will fin..."
entries.dialogueText: “No need to exaggerate. We will find something in the future. I am sure.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Yes. Really.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. Really.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I just wanted to let you know that..."
entries.dialogueText: “I just wanted to let you know that I will keep my eyes open. I will make sure the truth comes out about HOS.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Make sure you don't let emotions a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Make sure you don't let emotions affect your judgement.”
entries.menuText: “Make sure you don't let emotions affect your judgement.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good work, Lileas. Keep at it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good work, Lileas. Keep at it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“In time, I am sure it will.”"
entries.dialogueText: “In time, I am sure it will.”
entries.menuText: “In time, I am sure it will.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Never.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Never.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Thank you, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We were so close to getting him.""
entries.dialogueText: “We were so close to getting him."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Anyway. I won't take up more of yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Anyway. I won't take up more of your time.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Have a nice day.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Have a nice day.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as she turned her back to l..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as she turned her back to leave, I couldn't help but smirk.
